cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government digital-skills programme for the public is in service and has trained a stated number of people.
cells.note: The ICT agency ANTIC ran its sixth Digital Skills Campaign in July 2024, and the posts minister launched a Digital Citizenship Festival to train 50,000 young people in June 2025. No count of people trained has been found, so not stage 3.
